change: Anchor only the first purchased Cosmic history.featuresBefore to the original empty features and mode.startMultiplier. Legal subsequent energy changes are preserved.

browser.method: Actual CosmicEscapeUI, ExpansionClient and WalletClient make HTTP requests to a local test adapter backed by real DemoWalletStore and isolated PostgreSQL. Constructed natural 3/4/5-portal seeds and purchased modes verify accounting and display, not frequencies or RTP. Two viewport sizes and stakes20/100. Recovery includes actual reload during a partially played bonus and deliberate lost responses after committed start, continuation and final settlement. Reduced motion changes presentation only. No production requests, player data, production auth or full host/chat layout claims.

limitations: Browser verification uses the real Cosmic UI and wallet clients against a local isolated wallet adapter, not production authentication or the complete host with chat.
Historical profile metadata is constructed for local regression tests; no production player data was read.
Replay digest fields are validated for format and coverage by the fast gate; full qualification reruns the real server checks. Analytical RTP bounds are independently recomputed by the gate.
browserHarnessRetry: The first partial browser run was interrupted by Vite watching tsconfig files created by another active task under artifacts. Automatic watching and HMR were disabled in the audit harness; the complete rerun passed27scenarios. Manual reload and response-loss tests remain enabled.

qualification.interpretation: Deterministic outward bounds for the complete paid capped round, not a point estimate or statistical confidence interval.

cleanup.activeWorkExceptions: Other tasks' artifacts and checkouts were not touched. Current dist, dist-server, active module packages and normal dependencies remain.
cleanup.spaceInterpretation: Logical removed bytes are measured. Changes in filesystem free space include concurrent work and are not attributed solely to this cleanup.
